headline: Five Friday Cards, Zero Flips, One Pending Line Clears
dek: Friday morning conference call. Five college games tonight, five screens, and somebody is still stuck on mute for the roll call.
body_markdown:
**THE FORMULA:** "Can you hear me now, or am I talking to myself again?"

**NEXT MAN UP:** "We hear you. Start the holds."

**Who's holding**
- The Formula: all five Friday sides and totals, unchanged.
- Next Man Up: all five Friday sides and totals, unchanged.
- Letdown Watch: no card on these five, nothing to change.
- Follow The Money: four games unchanged. On New Mexico at Nevada, the published card was still pending; the fresh run clears to no side and no total. Shows the market; not in the score average.
- In The Trenches: all five Friday reads unchanged. Sides only.

**New Mexico at Nevada: pending clears, nobody moves a cover**

**FOLLOW THE MONEY:** "Published card still said pending. Fresh Action Network consensus has New Mexico Lobos −10 and 38.5. Opened Nevada Wolf Pack +9.5 and 38.5. Half-point on the spread, total flat. No side. No total."

**THE FORMULA:** "I've got New Mexico Lobos 29, Nevada Wolf Pack 18. Lobos −10, Over. Same card."

**NEXT MAN UP:** "New Mexico Lobos 28, Nevada Wolf Pack 17. Same −10, same Over."

**IN THE TRENCHES:** "Run games point at different teams. Still no side."

**Everybody else: sticking**
- Virginia Tech at SMU: Action Network consensus SMU Mustangs −6.5, total 56.5 (matches DraftKings on ESPN). The Formula sticks with Virginia Tech Hokies +6.5 and Under 56.5. Next Man Up sticks with SMU Mustangs −6.5 and Over 56.5. Follow The Money still no side, Over 56.5. In The Trenches still no side. Cover Writer sticks with SMU Mustangs 32, Virginia Tech Hokies 25, SMU Mustangs −6.5, Over 56.5. ACC availability report (Kickoff Status, update posted Thu Nov 5, 6:00 PM PT): Virginia Tech out includes George Ballance, Justin Terry, Lucas Austin, Luke Stuewe, Marlen Bright, Nathaniel Wright and more; Emmett Laws questionable. SMU out includes Abel Hoopii, Carterrious Brown, I'Zayah Young, Ira Singleton IV, Jaelyn Davis-Robinson, Link Rhodes and more; Ahmaad Moses questionable. Ethan Grunkemeyer and Kevin Jennings still the featured quarterbacks in the recent boxes. Nothing flips a side or a total.
- South Florida at East Carolina: consensus East Carolina Pirates −2.5, total 39.5. The Formula and Next Man Up stick with South Florida Bulls +2.5 and Over 39.5. Follow The Money sticks with East Carolina Pirates −2.5, no total. In The Trenches still no side. Cover Writer sticks with South Florida Bulls 23, East Carolina Pirates 22, South Florida Bulls +2.5, Over 39.5. American availability report not posted yet (Kickoff Status expects it around 2:30 PM PT). Unofficial notes only; no confirmed starter change that moves the fresh run.
- Nebraska at Illinois: consensus Nebraska Cornhuskers −4.5, total 50.5. The Formula sticks with Nebraska Cornhuskers −4.5 and Over 50.5. Next Man Up sticks with Illinois Fighting Illini +4.5 and Over 50.5. Follow The Money still no side and no total. In The Trenches still no side. Cover Writer sticks with Nebraska Cornhuskers 27, Illinois Fighting Illini 24, Illinois Fighting Illini +4.5, Over 50.5. Big Ten availability report (Kickoff Status, posted Thu Nov 5, 5:00 PM PT): Nebraska out includes Anthony Jones Jr., Gabe Moore, Jacob Bower, Jase Reynolds, Kahmir Prescott, Larry Miles and more. Illinois out includes Ca'Lil Valentine, Carter Smith, Demetrius John, Grant Beerman, Jayshon Platt, Kai Pritchard and more; BJ Thurman doubtful; Michael Clayton II questionable. Unofficial note lists Katin Houser returned. Fresh run does not flip.
- TCU at Arizona: consensus Arizona Wildcats −7.5, total 46.5. The Formula sticks with TCU Horned Frogs +7.5 and Under 46.5. Next Man Up sticks with Arizona Wildcats −7.5 and Under 46.5. Follow The Money sticks with TCU Horned Frogs +7.5 and Over 46.5. In The Trenches sticks with Arizona Wildcats −7.5. Cover Writer sticks with Arizona Wildcats 26, TCU Horned Frogs 16, Arizona Wildcats −7.5, Under 46.5. Big 12 availability report (Kickoff Status, posted Thu Nov 5, 7:00 PM PT): TCU out includes Braden Bach, Cade Bennett, Cooper Reid, Devondre McGee, Jon Denman, Julius Simms and more. Arizona out includes Cam Chapa, Ezra Funa, Jay'Vion Cole, Kevin Moorer Jr., R.J. Mosley, Shane King; Ismail Mahdi and Max Harris questionable. No flip on the fresh run.
- The number: Action Network consensus as of 9:23 AM ET matches every published Friday card number (SMU −6.5 / 56.5; East Carolina −2.5 / 39.5; Nebraska −4.5 / 50.5; New Mexico −10 / 38.5; Arizona −7.5 / 46.5). Small open-to-now moves already baked into the published Follow The Money cards do not flip a covering side or over/under side this morning.
- Weather (National Weather Service hourly, checked 9:23 AM ET): Dallas for the 7:00 PM ET kickoff about 69 degrees, partly cloudy, north wind 10 mph. Greenville for 7:30 PM ET about 66 degrees, slight chance rain showers, northwest wind 6 mph. Champaign for 8:00 PM ET about 40 degrees, mostly clear, north-northwest wind 5 mph. Reno for 9:00 PM ET about 54 degrees, mostly clear, calm. Tucson for 10:15 PM ET about 62 degrees, partly cloudy, northwest wind 5 mph. Nothing that rewrites a total on the fresh run.
- The Cover Writer: every Friday pick stands. Virginia Tech at SMU: SMU Mustangs 32, Virginia Tech Hokies 25, SMU Mustangs −6.5, Over 56.5. South Florida at East Carolina: South Florida Bulls 23, East Carolina Pirates 22, South Florida Bulls +2.5, Over 39.5. Nebraska at Illinois: Nebraska Cornhuskers 27, Illinois Fighting Illini 24, Illinois Fighting Illini +4.5, Over 50.5. New Mexico at Nevada: New Mexico Lobos 28, Nevada Wolf Pack 17, New Mexico Lobos −10, Over 38.5. TCU at Arizona: Arizona Wildcats 26, TCU Horned Frogs 16, Arizona Wildcats −7.5, Under 46.5.

**Closing button:** Five games, zero handicapper flips, zero Cover Writer flips. Watch the American report this afternoon for South Florida and East Carolina. Hang up.

**Changes**
- Follow The Money, New Mexico at Nevada: published card still showed side pending and total pending (stale Monday-night window). Fresh college_build rerun on Nov 6 clears to no side pick and no total pick against Action Network consensus New Mexico Lobos −10 and 38.5 as of 9:22 AM ET. That is not a covering-side or over/under flip, so it is not a row in college/pick_changes.json.
- No handicapper entries in college/pick_changes.json for the Friday, Nov 6, 2026 college games as of 9:33 AM ET.
- Cover Writer: no flips. Not one of the five public handicappers, so nothing for pick_changes.json either way.
